verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs say it can export the entire graph in open formats: EDN, JSON, standard Markdown, OPML, Roam JSON and HTML. Community users also confirm that their data stays local and that they back it up through GitHub, which makes leaving straightforward. One user reports that Logseq's native Markdown files add spacing that other tools such as Obsidian don't handle cleanly. Another notes that the newer DB version no longer stores data as Markdown files. Neither contradicts the documented export, but both point to migration friction. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence that a full-graph export imports cleanly into another tool, and confirmation that full open-format export carries over to the DB version.
